create_vpredictor: create a VPredictor instance with a DiscreteGaussianSchedule and optional clamp function
predict_x0: predict the original sample x0 from a v-prediction, noisy input xt, and timestep t
predict_noise: predict the noise epsilon from a v-prediction, noisy input xt, and timestep t
review_vpredictor_class: review the VPredictor class and its predict_x0 and predict_noise methods
summarize_vpredictor: summarize the VPredictor class which computes predicted noise and x0 using v-prediction
